speed.note: Fixed physical range, identical for every split; not fitted from data.

fmc_norm_source: Global min/max of the 375 training samples only; validation and test reuse these values.

scatter.input: sample FMC minus the uniform-medium FMC, then one affine map using the training-set min/max of that scattering field
scatter.reason: The full FMC is 99.3% a sample-independent direct arrival; the 0.7% differential collapses under the specified architecture (evidence in reports/m3_m4_report.md). A defect-free reference acquisition is available in practice.
scatter.scope: input preprocessing only; speed normalization, network structure and training settings are unchanged

loader.note: On-demand HDF5 reads; the 8.3 GB dataset is not preloaded because host RAM is 15.6 GB.

model.architecture: pointwise lifting -> learnable linear T(1000->200) and R(64->200) -> 4 Fourier layers -> 2-layer pointwise MLP; no U-Net branch, no attention, no physics loss

train.note: No early stopping; the cosine schedule spans the full 500 epochs (~6000 steps), matching the paper-scale iteration count the M4 run never reached.

eval.metrics: relative L2, MAE and RMSE in m/s on validation; SSIM on the 200x200 speed map with data_range 4300 m/s

purpose: M4b budget diagnostic: identical data, input, model, loss, lr, batch and seed as M4; the only change is the training budget (500 epochs, no early stopping).
